ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence? (1 mark)
   A. Say Founders of Schools of jurisprudence has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Founders of Schools of jurisprudence.
   C. Use Founders of Schools of jurisprudence to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Translation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Say Translation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Translation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Translation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Translation of the Qur’an.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of Sharia? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Secondary sources of Sharia.
   B. Use Secondary sources of Sharia to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Secondary sources of Sharia has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of Sharia with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf.
   C. Use The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc? (1 mark)
   A. Say Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc has no place in daily life.

   D. Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Ijtihad? (1 mark)

   B. Say Ijtihad has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ijtihad with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ijtihad.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith? (1 mark)

   B. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Ulum al- Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Ulum al- Hadith has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Apply the teaching of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

13. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
